Create clear, high-craft workflows for querying, filtering, comparison, drill-down, visualization, alerting, and sharing.

-

Make complex concepts—including data freshness, coverage, reliability, uncertainty, experiment assignment, metric validity, rollout state, and regressions—understandable and actionable.

-

Partner closely with engineering, data science, research, and product management to translate deeply technical infrastructure into elegant, coherent product experiences.

-

Use prototyping, research, and rigorous design exploration to establish interaction patterns for emerging technical and AI-native workflows.

-

Define shared systems and patterns that create consistency across OpenAI’s enterprise and internal tools.

-

Establish a high bar for information architecture, visual hierarchy, interaction quality, and craft across complex, multi-surface products.

You might thrive in this role if you:

-

Have substantial experience owning data products, observability platforms, experimentation systems, analytics products, developer tools, AI/ML tooling, or similarly technical workflows.

-

Are a strong product and systems thinker who can set direction in an ambiguous space and make durable interaction and platform decisions.

-

Can make dense information feel calm, legible, and useful without oversimplifying important complexity.

-

Are technically fluent, enjoy learning how underlying systems work, and can build credibility with engineers and other highly technical users.

Have redesigned workflows spanning multiple tools, products, or surfaces and can create coherence across a broader ecosystem.

-

Have strong UX/UI and interaction design skills, with a high bar for contemporary visual craft and information design.

Can demonstrate how your work changed product decisions, accelerated learning, or improved the velocity of the teams you supported.

This is a general track role, hiring for opportunities across all levels of seniority in our Sales Teams.

Apply here if you believe you possess outstanding revenue generating experience from the Technology industry.

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.

We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.

Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.

Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.

We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.

In building our sales team, we look for five things:

- Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems

- High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence

- Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes

- Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions

- Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers

Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.

The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.

Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open roles in every region.

What your day will look like

- Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory

- Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting

- Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events

- Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets

- Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives

- Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle

- Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers’ business problems

- Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities

- Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce

- Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers

What we are looking for in you

- Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science

- Experience of open source technology and solutions

- Detail oriented with effective follow-up

- Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution

- Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins

- Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team

- Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market

- Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events

Additional skills of interest

- Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech

- Experience speaking at conferences or industry events

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

- Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

- Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

- Annual compensation review

- Recognition rewards

- Annual holiday leave

- Maternity and paternity leave

- Employee Assistance Program

- Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

- Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.  Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

About Datadog:

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence.

The Team:

The Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team analyzes company financial data (revenue, customers, headcount, expenses, etc.) in order to support the business's growth and success. Within FP&A, the R&D Finance team enables the financial strategy behind Datadog's Engineering and Product organizations. This role sits specifically within hosting cost and cloud margin reporting, reporting directly to the FP&A Manager who owns hosting cost analysis, cloud gross margin modeling, and forecasting.

The Opportunity:

As the first dedicated analyst hire supporting Datadog's hosting cost and cloud margin function, you will own key components of the recurring reporting, close, and forecasting processes that provide visibility into one of Datadog’s largest and most strategically important cost areas. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, FinOps, Capacity Planning, and Vendor Management through a financial lens, with a clear growth path into broader cloud finance and FinOps scope as you build fluency in the space.

What You'll Do:

- Partner with FP&A leadership to manage recurring forecast updates, review cycles, and board-ready materials.

- Help manage portions of the recurring hosting close, including savings reporting, cost allocation, and key operational drivers.

- Assist in maintaining the hosting forecast models across Excel and Pigment.

- Participate in recurring review cadences with FinOps and Engineering partners to align on capacity planning, savings plan coverage, and cost allocation decisions.

- Partner with Controllership on accounting support for monthly hosting close files.

- Work on ad hoc projects and process improvements, including identifying opportunities to automate recurring, manual steps in the close process.

- Become proficient with financial planning, cost monitoring, and BI tools, including Pigment, Snowflake, Metabase, and Datadog's own Cloud Cost Management (CCM) product.

Who You Are:

- 2+ years of professional experience in FP&A, Strategic Finance, Accounting, Data Analytics, or a Cloud Finance/FinOps-adjacent role.

- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, or economics

- Strong Excel skills, including comfort working within large, formula-driven models.

- High attention to detail and reliability on recurring, deadline-driven close work

- Clear, concise communicator who can work independently once ramped, with a humble mindset and 'can-do' attitude

Bonus Points:

- Exposure to SQL, not required on day one, but a skill you're motivated to build

- Exposure to cloud commitment-based pricing (savings plans, committed use discounts, reserved capacity) and how they translate into gross margin

- Interest in cloud unit economics: cost per unit of usage, capacity utilization, vendor cost negotiations

- Experience with or interest in Pigment or similar FP&A planning tools

- Interest in process automation as a growth area within the role

- Understanding of a consumption-based software business model

- Hands-on experience with BI/reporting tools such as Tableau or Metabase

Benefits and Growth:

- Generous and competitive benefits package

- New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan

- Continuous career development and pathing opportunities, including a clear growth track from recurring hosting reporting into broader cloud finance and FinOps scope

- Product training to develop an in-depth understanding of our product and space

- Friendly and inclusive workplace culture

Work Location (Hybrid):

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. This role will require you to work in the office 3 days per week, and flexible the remainder.

- Assess commercial viability, profitability and operational implications of new business opportunities.

About Alloy River

Alloy River builds agentic applied AI for finance and accounting. Accounting today is fragmented, manual, and reactive. We believe it should be intelligent, structured, and operationally decisive. Our mission is to transform finance from a slow, labor-intensive, reporting function into a real-time, strategic engine for profit and control.

We re-architected the general ledger from first principles, and layered automation, workflow orchestration, and applied AI directly into its core. Instead of accountants moving data between tools and managing checklists, our system produces outcomes, surfaces exceptions, and compounds leverage over time. This is not incremental improvement. It is a ground-up redesign of financial infrastructure for an AI-native world.

We raised over $30m to date from Portage Ventures, Electric Capital, Elad Gil, and angels like Tobi Lütke, Balaji Srinivasan, and many more. We’re scaling what we do with the best builders, operators, and craftspeople in the world.

Role Overview

Alloy River acquires accounting firms and runs them on our platform. This role runs month-end close for those clients, and brings the accounting judgment that shapes what we build next. You'll close the books, map how each client's close actually works, and find the parts worth automating. This role is what lets us scale month-end across every firm we acquire, and turn what we learn from each client into a better product. For the right person, it is a rare path from running the close to shaping the software that automates it, building real AI and product fluency along the way.

What You'll Work On

Run month-end close for clients, some on our platform and some on legacy ledgers.

Interview clients to map their month-end process, and turn it into clear, repeatable SOPs.

Perform variance analysis and explain what the numbers are saying.

Handle ad hoc requests from clients.

Find inefficiencies in the close, and help automate what doesn't work.

Add input as the accounting voice for the product team, with clear feedback on what to build and how.

What We're Looking For

CPA designation (or in progress).

2+ years of accounting experience.

Hands-on experience running month-end close and variance analysis.

Experience documenting financial processes, such as SOP's, process maps and/or close checklists.

Strong relationship skills. You'll work directly with clients and firm owners.

A real drive to improve processes, not just run them.

High work ethic.

Bonus experience includes:

Experience with QuickBooks Online or Xero.

Bilingual (French).

How We Work

You'll report to our Head of Deployment and work closely with her from day one.

Most of the work is month-end close, with some support on automation.

You don't need to be AI-forward yet. We'll teach you in the role.

Your feedback goes straight to the product team and shapes the platform.

We are in-person every day.

Why Join Alloy River

Help create a category-defining product with a real impact on business owners.

Work in-person with people who are excellent at what they do and fun to be around.

Join early and shape the future of an industry.

What We Look For

We hire high agency, AI-forward builders. The title or background matters less than the pattern underneath it.

High agency.

You don't wait to be pointed. You identify the problem, form a view, and act.

AI-forward.

You've changed how you work because of AI - not as a novelty, but because of how it lets you build. Your first instinct is to reach for the agent, not the keyboard.

Strong opinions.

You have a perspective and you share it - in writing, in meetings, in Slack. You think out loud and you're not afraid to change your mind in public.

Ownership.

You feel responsible for outcomes, not just doing your part. You've built something that didn't exist before you arrived, and you didn't let go until it was right.

Curiosity.

You go deep without being asked. You ask the questions others skip. You tinker.

Optimistic.

You believe that things can improve, problems can be solved, and people are generally trying their best. This is the foundation of how you work and how you treat people.

Compensation & Location

This role pays $70,000-$90,000 CAD. This role is in-person full-time at our gorgeous office in Liberty Village, Toronto.

On Working In-Person

The full team is in the office every day, because we believe the best work happens when smart people are in the same room. You get faster decisions, tighter feedback loops, direct access to everyone on the team, and a level of trust that's hard to build over Zoom. If you thrive in that environment, you'll love it here.

Benefits

Competitive pay

100% covered health insurance

A gorgeous loft office in Liberty Village

Flexible PTO

AI Usage Policy

We may use AI to help review candidate applications, but the final decision is always made by a human.

job_desc:
About Us

Radical Numerics

is an AI research lab building general biological intelligence. Our mission is to master the code of life, and our purpose is to reduce human suffering.

Our team created Evo, and started the field of

generative genomics

. Our work was featured on the cover of

Science

, and presented by our CEO on the main stage of

TED2025

. Evo was used to create the first AI-generated CRISPR-Cas9, and the first

AI whole genome

from scratch.

Evo 2

, featured in Nature, is the largest fully open source AI project across any domain.

In October, we introduced Omnii-1, the world's most advanced multimodal genome language model, and a leap toward general biological intelligence. It unifies 28 biological modalities, spanning DNA, RNA, proteins, epigenomics, and more, in a single model trained on trillions of tokens of biological data In a

world first

, Omnii-1 designed the first AI-generated bacteriophages to be administered to a human patient with an antibiotic-resistant infection under compassionate use. We released this news alongside seven other

project areas

, showing the model’s breadth of applications.

The same generative breakthroughs that enable life-saving cures also lowers the barrier to creating engineered threats and AI-generated bioweapons. We believe these forces are inseparable. Radical Numerics was founded to develop both the power to design and the responsibility to defend.

About the Role

As our first dedicated People Operations lead, you'll own the full scope of how Radical Numerics supports its team: compensation, benefits, immigration, onboarding, compliance, and the systems that keep a fast-growing research lab running smoothly. This is a high-impact role for someone who enjoys building from the ground up and wants their work to directly shape how a company grows.

You'll work closely with our CEO, Recruiter, and Operations Manager to shape the employee experience from start to finish. Once a candidate accepts an offer, you'll take the lead and stay with them throughout their time here, from securing visas to making day one seamless, to running performance reviews and handling exits with care. Your goal is to make sure every person on our team feels supported, informed, and set up to do their best work.

Our team spans Tokyo and San Francisco. You'll bring clarity and structure the onboarding process, coordinating across countries, regulations, and time zones so that our people can focus on their research.

Much of our people infrastructure is still being built, and that's where you come in. You'll design the policies and processes we need, run them for the first time, and refine them into repeatable systems that scale as we grow. If you're energized by ambiguity and want to build something lasting, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Own compensation and leveling. Maintain comp ranges and the employee-levels mapping, and run equity scenario modeling and benchmarking for new roles.

Plan and run performance review cycles in Complete.

Own onboarding and offboarding end to end, including welcome and pre-start communications, background checks, I-9 verification, system access, and departing-employee accounts.

Serve as primary contact with immigration counsel for O-1 petitions, OPT/EAD cases, and green card renewals, and act as company signatory where appropriate.

Administer Justworks, including benefits, open enrollment, and state registrations for remote employees.

Answer employee and candidate questions about benefits and policy.

Set up and manage international employment through EOR arrangements as needed.

Partner with outside employment counsel on employee relations, performance concerns, terminations, and changes to offer letters and CIIAs.

Lead planning on office move scenarios and timelines with our real estate partners alongside our Operations Manager.

Build the policies, handbook, and compliance practices a growing company needs before it needs them.

What We're Looking For

You have run People Operations at an early-stage company and can explain the systems you built, not just the ones you inherited.

You have hands-on experience with U.S. employment immigration, especially O-1, OPT and H1Bs and know how to keep timelines and counsel moving.

You understand startup compensation, including bands, leveling, and equity, and can model tradeoffs clearly for leadership.

You know PEO and EOR platforms such as Justworks, and understand multi-state and international employment compliance.

You exercise judgment on sensitive issues and know when to bring in counsel.

You are organized enough to run many open threads at once without dropping any, and you document them so someone else could pick them up.

You are comfortable creating a process before there is a playbook.

You are excited about building a generational company at the intersection of AI and biology.

about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our

principles

to see how we work.

mission

As Workplace & People Operations Manager at telli, you own the environment our team does its best work in. You're responsible for keeping our Berlin office running smoothly day to day: workplace processes, people ops, internal events, and the culture initiatives that make telli feel like telli.

run our Berlin office: supplies, equipment, and making sure we stay productive and well-organized

drive culture initiatives that keep the team connected as we grow

own the employee lifecycle, from onboarding (so new joiners have desk, hardware, and access ready before they walk in) to offboarding

build automations around workplace and people ops (ordering, inventory, requests) with AI and no-code tools

jump in wherever help is needed, because no two weeks look the same

what makes you a great fit:

you have a few years of experience in workplace, office, or people operations, ideally at a startup

you're hands-on and happy to do the unglamorous work that makes everything else possible

you're organized, reliable, and notice the details others miss

Introduction

THG Ingenuity is a leading ecommerce and technology business, powering some of the world's most recognised brands. Our Search & Social team sits within the wider Commerce division, operating at the intersection of ecommerce, marketing, and commercial strategy. Alongside our Content and Paid Media teams, we connect brands with customers through world-class organic and paid search strategies.

We're looking for an ambitious, detail-oriented graduate to join our team and help shape the future of search. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a passion for SEO to build a career at the forefront of digital marketing, working on Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI-driven search within a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Success in this role requires a deep curiosity for search engine algorithms, strong analytical skills, commercial awareness, and the ability to build positive relationships with internal teams (like eCommerce, Paid Media, and project management) and external brand clients.

The Role

As an SEO & GEO Executive, you will support the planning, execution, optimisation, and reporting of organic search campaigns across multiple brands. You will work to grow organic visibility, traffic, and revenue, ensuring our clients dominate the search engine results pages (SERPs).

You'll work in close partnership with our Paid Media team to ensure our organic and paid search strategies are fully aligned. You'll also collaborate daily with the eCommerce teams who are trading the sites, project teams managing site onboards, and external brand partners, ensuring SEO is a core pillar of our commercial success.

This role combines technical SEO, content strategy, performance analysis, and stakeholder management, providing a well-rounded foundation in the future of search.

- Support the end-to-end delivery of SEO strategies for multiple brands.

- Conduct keyword research, content gap analysis, and SERP analysis to identify new growth opportunities.

- Perform technical SEO audits to identify and fix issues related to site architecture, crawlability, and indexation.

- Collaborate with content teams to ensure on-page content is optimised for both users and search engines.

- Analyse and report on organic performance using Google Search Console, GA4, and industry-standard search analytics platforms.

- Work closely with the Paid Media team to share search query insights, coordinate keyword targeting, and develop a unified search strategy.

- Support project teams with SEO requirements for site migrations and new client onboards.

- Stay informed on algorithm updates, competitor activity, and emerging trends, particularly in AI-driven search and GEO.

- Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders (eCommerce, Content, Paid Media) and external brand clients.

About You

We're looking for someone who is:

- A recent graduate with a primary passion for SEO and organic search, and a keen interest in related fields like Paid Media, eCommerce, client services, or digital marketing.

- Highly organised with strong time management and prioritisation skills.

- Detail-oriented with exceptionally high standards of accuracy and quality.

- Commercially aware and interested in how SEO drives business performance.

- A strong communicator with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Professional, collaborative and able to build positive stakeholder relationships with both internal teams and external clients.

At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. About

Inspira Education

Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities.

As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide.

As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub).

The Role

We’re looking for a Junior Content Editor to help keep everything we publish accurate, clear, and polished. You’ll work alongside our senior editors, SEO team, writers, and subject-matter experts to take drafts from rough to publish-ready across our blogs, guides, and marketing content.

This is a great fit if you have a sharp eye for detail, love making sentences better, and want to grow into a more strategic editorial role. You’ll learn how content gets found and cited by search engines and AI tools, and you’ll build real skills in editorial process, style, and feedback.

Please note: This role is open to candidates based remotely in Canada.

What You’ll Do

Edit for quality

Catch spelling, grammar, factual, and formatting errors before content goes live.

Rewrite passive constructions into active voice and replace jargon with plain language.

Tighten wordy sentences without losing the point.

Check that headings are logical and accurately reflect the content beneath them.

Verify stats, claims, and quotes against primary sources, and flag anything unverified.

Apply our style guide

Apply Inspira’s house style consistently across punctuation, capitalization, formatting, and tone.

Flag style deviations for writers rather than silently fixing them, so they learn the rules over time.

Suggest updates to the style guide as you spot patterns or gaps.

Edit for search and AI discoverability

Make sure each section leads with its main point rather than burying the answer.

Help break content into clear, self-contained sections that answer a specific question.

Spot forced keywords or unnatural phrasing, and make the writing read naturally for people first.

Check that link text is descriptive and specific (no “click here”).

Follow our SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) guidelines as you edit.

Support the editorial workflow

Keep multiple pieces moving through briefs, review stages, and approvals on deadline.

Give writers clear, constructive feedback that explains the reason behind each change.

Work with coaches and subject-matter experts to clarify and strengthen their drafts.

Help document and improve our editorial processes as we scale.

What We’re Looking For

Required

2–3 years of professional editing or copyediting experience (digital publishing, content marketing, agency, or similar).

Excellent command of grammar, punctuation, and style, plus the judgment to know when a rule should flex.

A sharp eye for detail and a commitment to catching errors before they ship.

Ability to give kind, specific, actionable feedback to writers.

Comfort working with subject-matter experts and non-professional writers.

Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Familiarity with SEO fundamentals (search intent, on-page best practices) and curiosity about how AI-driven search is changing content.

A portfolio or a few before/after editing samples you can walk us through.

Based remotely in Canada

Experience with style guides, whether using or contributing to one.

Experience editing for admissions, higher education, or other high-stakes audiences.

Familiarity with a CMS (WordPress, Webflow, or similar) and tools like Google Docs, Notion, or Asana.

Basic understanding of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

About the Team

Safety Systems works to ensure OpenAI’s most capable models can be developed and deployed responsibly. Our work spans evaluations, safeguards, red teaming, deployment decisions, and the systems that help OpenAI understand and reduce risk as models become more capable and widely used.

Within Safety Systems, the Trustworthy AI team is growing its safety transparency function: a practice focused on helping external audiences understand OpenAI’s technical safety work with greater clarity, rigor, and continuity. We create and improve the public artifacts that explain how our systems are evaluated for safety, what safeguards we build, what decisions we make, and where uncertainty remains.

This work includes system cards, the Deployment Safety Hub, safety-related blogs, public governance documents, and other outputs that communicate technical safety topics to external audiences. It also includes building new ways to make technical safety information easier to understand, navigate, and use—including AI-assisted workflows, data visualizations, and interactive tools that make complex technical work more legible over time.

About the Role

We are looking for a Safety Transparency Editor to own the editorial quality of key safety transparency artifacts and systems.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can write crystal-clear, pitch-perfect explanations of the hardest and highest-stakes technical safety topics that OpenAI tackles, and who can lean into AI to build systems that help the broader organization do this work better.

Your core responsibility is to shape and execute how our technical safety work is externally communicated: identifying the narrative thread, exercising judgment about which details matter, determining where additional context, explanation, or supporting evidence is needed, translating complexity without sacrificing precision, and helping external audiences understand both the safety measures we’ve taken and the uncertainties that remain. To do this work effectively, you will need to be comfortable educating yourself, using AI tools and existing internal evidence, about the nuances of technical safety work taking place across OpenAI.

You will serve as the editorial driver behind system cards and related transparency materials, partnering closely with Safety Programs, researchers, evaluators, red-teamers, policy experts, legal partners, product marketing and communications teams, and other launch stakeholders. You will transform complex technical safety topics into public-facing artifacts that are rigorous, accessible, and faithful to the underlying substance.

You’ll also be expected to use AI deeply in your own practice—not simply as a learning and drafting tool, but as a means of rethinking how this work gets done. You should instinctively look for opportunities to build workflows, automate repetitive tasks, improve consistency, and create systems that enable the organization to produce high-quality transparency artifacts at scale and speed.

This role demands deep ownership and accountability. The ideal candidate is equally at home refining a tricky explanation of a nuanced technical point, and investing in building systems that make the next ten explanations easier to produce.

This role is ideal for someone who combines the judgment of an exceptional editor with the mindset of a builder. You should be comfortable using your voice and judgment while approaching the work with humility, intellectual honesty, and a deep respect for technical nuance.

In This Role, You Will

Serve as the narrative DRI for system cards and related transparency artifacts from initiation through publication.

Partner with the Safety Programs team, researchers, evaluators, red-teamers, policy experts, legal teams, communications partners, and launch teams to translate technical findings into public-facing materials.

Write clear, precise explanations of highly technical safety topics for external audiences without sacrificing rigor or nuance.

Shape the editorial structure and narrative arc of transparency artifacts, ensuring they accurately communicate what OpenAI has done, why it matters, and where uncertainty remains.

Exercise strong editorial judgment to determine what context is necessary, what caveats should be highlighted, and where additional explanation or supporting evidence may be needed to strengthen public understanding.

Improve repeatable editorial processes, templates, and publication workflows.

Use AI tools to accelerate drafting, synthesize source materials, identify precedents, prepare reviewer packets, and improve consistency across artifacts.

Build systems and workflows that make transparency efforts faster, more scalable, and more effective over time.

Support blogs, governance documents, technical explainers, and other technical safety communications when needed.

Help evolve the Deployment Safety Hub and related transparency surfaces over time.

Example Projects

Drive the narrative, framing, and technical writing and editing for a system card supporting a major model launch.

Translate novel evaluation methodologies, preparedness frameworks, and mitigation approaches into explanations accessible to policymakers, journalists, researchers, and external experts.

Build an AI-assisted workflow that improves consistency, quality, and efficiency of our safety transparency practice.

Help shape the evolution of the Deployment Safety Hub as a trusted destination for understanding OpenAI’s technical safety work.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You

Are an exceptional writer and editor who can make highly technical topics understandable without sacrificing precision.

Have strong editorial judgment and know how to identify the narrative thread in complex, ambiguous material, surfacing what details matter, what context is needed, and how to communicate uncertainty responsibly.

Have strong execution instincts and enjoy owning complex projects from start to finish.

Can synthesize diverse inputs into structured, publication-ready artifacts.

Have the confidence to use your voice and judgment while remaining humble, evidence-driven, and open to feedback.

Enjoy learning unfamiliar technical domains quickly and developing fluency in frontier AI safety concepts.

Customer Support Engineer (CSE)

About the Customer Support Engineering Team

The Fastly Edge Cloud Platform powers the best of the internet. Our Customer Support Engineering (CSE) team, a key function within our broader Customer Experience organization, helps customers succeed through clear, timely, and transparent technical support.

This opening is for a Customer Support Engineer, Tier I, an entry-level position within our three-tiered team (Tier I, Tier II, and Tier III) that offers multiple opportunities for career development within Fastly. You will work closely with Tier II and III engineers, Engineering, and our customer-facing partner teams, and you will learn our issue management process end to end.

We are seeking a technical problem solver for customers using our delivery and Compute platforms. The role requires a strong understanding of internet protocols and the ability to explain clearly how traffic behaves at the network edge. You will focus on delivery configuration (VCL), caching, HTTP behavior, and the Fastly Control Panel, with growing exposure to serverless Compute. Security product cases (such as WAF and DDoS) and general IT requests are handled by other teams.

What You'll Do:

- Written-first customer support: Resolve technical inquiries primarily through email and ticket, and also through chat (Slack) and portal engagements. Join live triage sessions by video or phone when a situation calls for it. You will work to define first-response targets, so clear and accurate written communication is essential.

- Edge troubleshooting: Review customer configurations and debug VCL logic, cache behavior (TTLs, hit ratio), HTTP headers, TLS, and DNS. Over time, build skills troubleshooting Compute (Wasm) applications.

- Control Panel and account guidance: Guide customers through the Fastly Control Panel, API and CLI, role-based access controls (RBAC), users and permissions, domains, and observability dashboards.

- Issue management and triage: Assess impact and urgency on every case, work it through our Tier I, II, and III lifecycle, and escalate to Engineering during business hours with clear evidence: what you verified, what you tried, and what you still don't know.

- Urgent and widespread issues: Recognize when an issue is urgent (for example, customer traffic is down) or affects multiple customers, and engage our after-hours incident response process quickly.

- Partnering with account teams: Know when to bring in Customer Success Management or Advanced Professional Services, such as when a customer's sentiment is changing or a request calls for configuration review or solution design, and hand off with a clear summary.

- Customer advocacy and continuous learning: Go beyond closing tickets by educating customers on edge architecture and troubleshooting methods. Share what you learn and contribute to our documentation.

- Live event monitoring and on-call: Monitor metrics during large network events and proactively report degradation to customers. This role includes an occasional on-call rotation managed through PagerDuty, covering weekends, select after-hours, and corporate holidays (which includes additional holiday pay).

What We're Looking For:

- Experience: 2-4 years in a technical support, sysadmin, or network-focused role.

- Protocol proficiency: Demonstrated understanding of HTTP/S, TCP/IP, TLS, and DNS, including the ability to explain how a webpage is delivered quickly.

- Scripting and programming foundation: Working ability in at least one language (for example VCL, Python, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, or Rust) and eagerness to learn VCL and Compute.

- UI and API literacy: Comfort navigating modern SaaS control panels and RESTful APIs, including from the command line.

- Customer communication: Strong written communication and analytical skills, with experience supporting customers by email, chat, ticketing system, or phone.

- Triage proficiency: Working knowledge of network telemetry and diagnostic tools (such as curl and traceroute/MTR), and the judgment to know when to ask for help.

- Networking fundamentals: Understanding of BGP, internet routing, and the difference between transit and peering.

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: Singapore

About the Team

The Cloudflare Customer Support Team solves complicated problems and answers technical questions via phone, email, chat and social media. Whether it is a Wordpress blogger using our services for free or a global Enterprise business with petabytes of web traffic, we are always eager to assist. We are the eyes and ears of Cloudflare, acting as the real-time voice of the customer to help communicate their needs and real-world use cases back to the rest of the company - for better service and future product development.

What You'll Do

Do you love solving complex technical issues and interacting with people? Are you passionate about providing premium-level support to customers and are a standout colleague? Cloudflare is seeking an experienced Technical Support Engineer for Application Services/Performance to join our team. You will work with our largest and most technically sophisticated customers on a variety of technical support issues to ensure they can deploy and operate Cloudflare's App Services solutions with confidence.

- Serve as a trusted technical advisor for our Enterprise customers, responding to and resolving inquiries and incidents related to Application Services/Performance, while delivering timely, high-quality and personalized assistance.

- Work directly with customers to diagnose, troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues involving DNS, HTTP Errors, IAM, Load Balancing, Caching, CORS, SSL/TLS, Network, and other Application Services/Performance related configurations.

- Work with Engineering and Operations teams to remediate issues, suggest steps to mitigate, and apply the appropriate mitigation, when applicable.

- Create and maintain knowledge base articles, technical guides, and troubleshooting documentation for internal and customer use.

- You have a solid grasp of problem-solving with command line tools (dig/traceroute/curl/tcpdump).

- You have experience writing scripts in Bash, Python, JavaScript, or other scripting language.

- You have experience installing and configuring web servers like Apache, Nginx, and IIS.

- Work with Engineering and Product teams to improve products and tools.

What We're Looking For

- You must have a minimum of 4 years’ experience working as a Technical Support Engineer supporting globally distributed reverse-proxy CDN platforms, with hands-on expertise in content caching, performance optimization, traffic routing, and edge delivery services similar to Cloudflare’s core network offerings.

- Exceptional troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for customers.

- Strong customer service orientation and communication skills, both written and verbal.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

- Strong understanding of L4/L7 protocols and concepts including, TCP/UDP, DNS, HTTP/S, IAM, Load Balancing, Caching, CORS, SSL/TLS, Network with a particular focus on Anycast concepts.

- Have experience using online diagnostic and monitoring platforms — including DNS lookup tools, global ping and traceroute testers, SSL/TLS configuration analyzers, and synthetic transaction or real-user monitoring services — to troubleshoot DNS resolution, network latency, certificate issues, and global service availability problems.

- Have experience using investigative observability tools such as Kibana, Grafana, Zabbix, Sentry, and live log-tailing utilities to analyze logs, trace issues, and pinpoint root causes of performance or reliability problems.

- Confident with command line and tools, including curl, dig, traceroute, openssl, git.

- Experience in a web development and / or hosting environment such as installing and configuring web servers like Apache, Nginx, Caddy and IIS.

- You are competent at writing scripts in Bash, Python, JavaScript or other scripting language.

- You have worked with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL, and other database servers.

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Bonus Points For

- Experience in a shift-based or global support environment.

- Familiarity with SLA/KPI metrics and real-time queue management.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

As a Customer Success Manager at Dropbox, you will own the post-sale customer strategy and relationship for a portfolio of customers. You will help customers realize measurable value from their investment while driving product adoption, retention, growth, and Net Revenue Retention (NRR).

You will serve as a trusted advisor throughout the customer journey, developing a deep understanding of each customer’s business priorities, technical environment, key stakeholders, and evolving needs. They bring strong Customer Success experience and a demonstrated ability to drive adoption, manage risk, support successful renewals, and deliver measurable retention and growth outcomes in a B2B SaaS environment.

- Partner closely with Sales and cross-functional teams to develop account strategies, remove technical and commercial blockers, mitigate renewal risks, and identify appropriate expansion opportunities.

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

This is an overnight shift role with working hours of 12:00am - 7:00am EST.

As a Support Engineer on our U.S. Government Support Engineering team, you operate at the critical intersection of Support and Engineering, enabling public sector organizations and United States government agencies to run GitLab in some of the most secure and constrained environments in the world. Your work directly supports national security missions, including customers operating within FedRAMP-authorized, air-gapped, and classified or semi-classified environments where traditional troubleshooting approaches are not always possible.

In this role, you will engage deeply with GitLab through the command line; analyzing logs, system behavior, and application performance with strong Linux fundamentals and an understanding of how GitLab’s components interact end-to-end. You may partner with Product and Engineering to reproduce and document edge-case defects using sanitized or redacted data, or contribute directly to the product by opening merge requests that resolve customer-impacting issues. Beyond resolving individual cases, you’ll help strengthen GitLab by improving documentation, support workflows, and institutional knowledge, ensuring that lessons learned in highly regulated environments benefit the broader platform; all while working in a fully remote, highly collaborative environment built on trust, autonomy, and shared ownership.

Some examples of our projects:

- A tool to quickly analyze strace output

- A solution to capture the state of a customer’s server for easier troubleshooting

- A functionality to ChatOps to make it easier to identify user accounts on GitLab.com

What you’ll do

- Collaborate closely with public sector customers, including U.S. government agencies, the Department of War, and Intelligence Community organizations, to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex issues in GitLab deployments operating under strict security, compliance, and operational constraints.

- Perform deep, hands-on technical investigations using Linux command-line tooling and GitLab internals to analyze logs, system performance, and application behavior, often with limited telemetry or incomplete datasets. You will trace issues across infrastructure, application, and code paths to identify root causes, recommend mitigations, and drive durable fixes; frequently partnering with GitLab Product, Development, and Infrastructure teams to ensure outcomes that meet both mission and platform reliability requirements.

- Create and update clear, reusable documentation and support content based on real customer interactions to improve self-service and reduce repeated issues.

- Participate in regular pairing sessions with other Support Engineers and act as a stable counterpart to cross-functional teams to share knowledge and improve support processes.

This is a shift role. Working 8-hour shifts with 4 weekdays and 1 weekend day.

You’ll interact with customers daily as they encounter the difficult edge cases of running GitLab in complex environments. We want to live in a world where everyone can contribute, and as a member of the support team, there are no barriers to using your skills to improve the experience of our users and customers.

- A tool to automatically check a GitLab Omnibus install for known issues

- A solution to capture the state of a customer’s server for easier troubleshooting

Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Stripe was built with simplicity in mind. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an Independent Business, Startup, SMB, or Enterprise and our mission is to provide all Stripe Users with the best support experience possible. Today, Stripe handles over a million support cases per year and processes millions of internal transactions. Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective of reducing risk and churn, facilitating the adoption of new products or services, and supporting expansion within existing accounts. - Step Growth - a selection of high-potential customers

- Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more.

- Collaborate with Sales, Field Engineering and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives.

- Excellent presentation skills with the ability to guide a conversation about complex software.

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

The Toast Enterprise Support team delivers advanced, omnichannel technical support to our most complex enterprise clients — corporate restaurant brands, national franchises, and international locations. As an Enterprise Support Expert, you'll resolve highly complex, high-risk technical issues across a broad and varied product landscape, manage demanding enterprise stakeholders, and bring order to a fast-paced, ambiguous environment — all while fielding incoming questions across phone, chat, and email.

What you’ll do (Responsibilities)

- Troubleshoot hardware, financial transaction mechanics, API integrations, and menu configuration issues across a wide range of Toast products for our Enterprise customers.

- Diagnose and resolve issues at the intersection of Toast and third-party systems, including 3rd party ordering APIs and enterprise accounting integrations, following established troubleshooting paths and escalating when a case falls outside documented guidance.

- Manage a steady mix of inbound case traffic across phone, chat, and email, keeping your active case backlog current and flagging aging cases to your lead or manager.

- Help triage incoming workload based on account tier and urgency, following team guidelines on prioritization.

- Communicate clearly across audiences — from front-of-house restaurant staff to corporate IT contacts — translating technical issues into actionable guidance.

- 2-4 years of experience in a Technical Support role responsible for customer satisfaction and championing the customer experience.

- Ability to quickly learn Toast's product suite, with the ability to apply that knowledge across a wide range of technical issues.

Samsara’s Customer Success team is on the front lines of business value delivery by helping customers adopt our platform, realize measurable business value, and renew and expand with confidence. Our Mid-Market Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner.

- Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills.

- Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders: executives, Sales, Product, Support, and Engineering leadership, and day-to-day users of our software.

- Experience working on a Renewal + Growth Quota

- Has a strong bias for action, the ability to think big, and insistence on high standards.

Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is globally expanding its Embedded Devices Software Solution Sales team, hiring managers, directors, and account managers to broaden reach in mission-critical industries. You will be responsible for carrying an annual bookings quota and must be comfortable positioning and selling a range of open source, services, and software solutions. Leveraging Ubuntu's market adoption, the work requires actively building trusted and profitable commercial relationships, developing the potential of your territory beyond managing inbound interest. This involves prospecting new business, maintaining existing relationships, and working with colleagues on account strategy. Candidates must be effective in selling complex technical solutions, including enterprise software, cloud, virtualization, and container technologies, to senior levels of the enterprise and departments focused on embedded software and IoT devices. Professional practice, clear account planning, continuous pipeline reporting, and the ability to travel regionally for client engagement and internationally for company events twice a year are expected.

Location: We are growing our sales reach with remote roles in all regions - EMEA, APAC, and Americas; and office based roles in Taipei, Taiwan.

- Building and executing a territory sales plan to prioritize leading security-focused brands and manufacturers

- Working with marketing to promote our brand and increase market awareness in prioritized accounts

- Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation

- Track record of achievement of sales targets and large account wins

- Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

We’re here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting . We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

Your Impact on our Mission

Zocdoc’s greatest asset is our people. As an Enterprise Sales Manager, you will lead a team of Sales Associates responsible for generating a strong, consistent pipeline across our large provider group and mid-market segments. You will coach and develop early-career sellers within a structured sales motion, driving measurable improvements in individual performance and enterprise pipeline outcomes. Success in this role is defined by your ability to consistently elevate team performance, deliver clear, data-driven impact within established processes, and develop high-potential talent into more senior roles such as Sales Executive, Account Executive, and Onboarding.

You’ll enjoy this role if you are…

- The kind of person who builds a culture of high performance and impact by establishing trust with their teams

- Able to work in a fast paced, high pressure environment, while driving results and getting things done

- The kind of leader who loves to roll your sleeves up, lead by example, and stay close to the work

- A relationship builder, who’s passionate about the healthcare industry and Zocdoc’s role in making it better for the patient

- Serious about your work, but not about yourself. Let’s face it - the way things are going, you kind of need a sense of humor

Your day to day is…

- Consistently driving strong results at the top of the funnel

- Digging into metrics and salesforce to uncover opportunities and trends; delivering those valuable insights to inform process improvements

- Actively seeking ways to raise the performance bar at all times

- Appropriately balancing quality and quantity leading indicators

- Driving results through repeatable and scalable processes

- Leading, motivating, and coaching Sales Associates to support ongoing skill development and career progression

- Fostering an innovative, autonomous mindset among reps, empowering them to take ownership of results

- Understanding individual motivations and tailoring coaching approaches to drive performance while developing future Sales Executives, Account Executives, and Onboarding talent

- Investing intentionally in team culture by rallying a distributed team around impact, mission, and shared priorities, while strengthening collaboration and belonging

- Increasing win rates by evolving sales processes and presentations, including developing new scripting, creating sales content, and partnering cross-functionally

- Partnering closely with the Bottom-of-Funnel team to build meaningful territory-based relationships and generate pipeline

You’ll be successful in this role if you have…

- An unrelenting desire to build more equitable, inclusive and diverse workplaces.  You view this role as an opportunity to create positive change

- A meaningful (2+ years) of sales leadership experience, preferably in the healthcare sector

- A proven track record of building teams that hit targets and accomplish goals

- A proven track record of working broadly across an organization, balancing multiple stakeholders across all tenure buckets (executive to individual contributor)

- Superb communication skills! You believe in keeping all of your stakeholders in the loop and know that multiple mediums of communication are the key to success

- Humility. You believe in treating all people with dignity and respect, regardless of title or tenure

Benefits

- Flexible, hybrid work environment at our convenient Soho location

- Unlimited Vacation

- 100% paid employee health benefit options (including medical, dental, and vision)

- Commuter Benefits

- 401(k) with employer funded match

- Corporate wellness program with Wellhub

- Sabbatical leave (for employees with 5+ years of service)

- Competitive paid parental leave and fertility/family planning reimbursement

- Cell phone reimbursement

- Catered lunch everyday along with beverages and snacks

- Employee Resource Groups and ZocClubs to promote shared community and belonging

- Great Place to Work Certified

Base salary offered is determined by a number of factors including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skills. Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay and/or equity; your recruiter will discuss the full compensation package details.

$144,500 — $195,500 USD

Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values . -   Work with merchants, from successful venture-backed startups to well established institutions; evaluating their business models and financial statements

- Help manage Stripe’s portfolio by developing a deep understanding of risk across industries, geographies, and operating models

- You excel in analytical thinking and problem solving

- You have a process-oriented mindset and ability to get things done

- You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross team collaboration and support

- You are able to prioritize and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment

- You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners

- You’re willing to work (no more than) one weekend day each month - you’ll receive a weekday off the following week; the SDC operates during daytime hours with shifts from the morning through early evening

Preferred qualifications

- Degree/diploma in Finance or Accounting

- Experience in payments, e-commerce, or fintech mitigating credit risk

About the job

Cross-Functional Governance & Leadership

- Drive Visible Governance Programs: Serve as the core Program Manager for a highly visible, cross-functional governance initiative spanning multiple areas of the business - including building and operationalizing programs from diagnosis, design, implementation, and change management

- Maintain Executive Visibility: Package and present operational narratives, risks, and performance metrics to cross-functional leadership, feeding into C-suite and Audit Committee reviews.

- Implement Core Infrastructure: Lead end-to-end process improvements across carrier operations — understanding, synthesizing, and deploying cohesive policies, workflows, systems/tools, and data-driven controls.

Operating Model, Enablement & Team Infrastructure

- Build Team Foundations: Design and stand up the new Carrier Operations & Governance operating model, operational cadences, and internal team structures.

- Data & Reporting Quality: Execute analytical requests from IRSG, Legal, Finance, and GTM stakeholders, delivering accurate data pulls, ad-hoc analyses, and structured summaries. Perform data quality checks and validation to ensure accuracy and consistency across reporting pipelines.

- Design Enablement & Change Management: Design and create comprehensive enablement programs, training materials, and frameworks to accelerate organizational transformation — actively shifting teams from relationship- and assumption-driven decision-making to a rigorously governed, data-informed operating model.

- Drive Team RTB Engine: Own and manage the day-to-day Run-the-Business (RTB) cadence at the team level, ensuring operational momentum and accountability.

- Facilitate Operational Rhythms: Facilitate regular operational forums, including team OKR tracking, and deal approval workflows.

- 5+ years of experience in management consulting or as a Program Manager or Chief of Staff in telecom, RevOps, or strategy and operations.

- Proven track record leading highly visible, cross-functional programs across business, technical, legal, and financial stakeholders.

- Demonstrated expertise driving end-to-end process improvements by integrating policies, business processes, IT/systems tools, and operational controls.

- Direct experience standing up operating models, team cadences, and operational documentation (runbooks, frameworks, ROEs).

- Proven track record in designing enablement content and driving organizational change.

- Experience driving Run-the-Business (RTB) cadences, OKR tracking, and operational reporting.

- Sharp written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting to executive leadership.

- Strong analytical proficiency using data tools (Excel/Google Sheets, SQL, or Looker) to measure performance and policy compliance.

Desired:

- Background in management consulting, high-growth tech, or global telecom environments.

- Operational experience within commercial Deal Desks, supplier QBR management, or revenue assurance.

- Own and maintain the review pipeline tracker as the single source of truth for the status, owner, and age of every in-flight review.

- Provide clear, regular status updates to the Director and stakeholders, and flag process improvements as patterns emerge.

Process Integrity

- Ensure every request follows the defined intake-to-approval path and that required review steps are completed before a purchase proceeds.

The CX Risk Coordinator is the analytical and execution engine of the CX Risk team. You will connect customer escalations to operational decisions: tracking trends, finding the pain points behind them, and leading the projects that fix them. This is not a support role. Responsibilities:

Incident Analysis & Response

- Classify and document incidents across the T1–T5 severity framework, ensuring accurate categorization and post-incident records

- Analyze escalation spikes to identify patterns (market, route, meal, or time-based) and surface findings proactively

- Contribute to incident post-mortems with structured root cause analysis

Process Improvement & Pain Point Discovery

- Map CX and operational workflows end to end and identify where they break, slow down, or generate credits and refunds

- Find pain points by combining escalation data, VOC feedback, and direct input from CX specialists, CX Ops, and market teams

- Size each pain point (volume, credit exposure, agent effort) so the team can prioritize what matters most

- Design and test solutions: process changes, documentation, templates, automations, or tooling requests

- Measure the before and after of every improvement and report whether it actually worked

Project Management

- Own CX Risk projects from scoping to delivery: define the problem, goal, success metric, owner, and deadline

- Keep projects visible and current in the team tracker, with clear status, next actions, and blockers

- Coordinate with stakeholders across CX Ops, Operations, Markets, Kitchens, and Product to unblock dependencies

- Escalate blockers early and follow up until they are resolved

- Communicate progress and outcomes in short, structured updates to the CX Risk Supervisor and leadership

Reporting & Intelligence

- Own the weekly escalation summary: top drivers by market, WoW trend, and at least one recommendation per cycle

- Maintain and evolve the Credits & Refunds dashboards, ensuring data accuracy and relevance

- Contribute to the monthly C&R Digest and VOC analyses shared with CX Leadership, Markets, and Kitchen Ops

Cross-functional Collaboration

- Present escalation data and project results in cross-functional meetings, with context and a clear recommendation

- Flag recurring root causes to the relevant team with supporting data and a suggested action

- Support CX Ops by auditing logistics channels during the afternoon window; surface issues, do not resolve them unilaterally

Qualifications:

- 2+ years of experience in a CX, Operations, or analytical role, ideally in a high-volume, logistics-adjacent environment

- Proven experience leading or coordinating projects end to end, with deadlines, stakeholders, and measurable outcomes

- A process-improvement mindset: you notice friction, ask why it happens, and push for a fix rather than a workaround

- Comfortable working with data: building spreadsheets, interpreting dashboards, and spotting anomalies without being prompted

- Strong written English: you can turn a table of numbers into a short summary a non-technical reader can act on

- Experience with Zendesk or a comparable CRM / ticketing platform

- Available to work EST hours, including evening coverage

Preferred Requirements:

- SQL knowledge for querying and analyzing data independently

- Experience with Google BigQuery

- Familiarity with process-improvement or project frameworks (Lean, root cause analysis, Kanban, or similar)

- Exposure to automation or scripting (Apps Script, Python, n8n, or similar)

- Familiarity with delivery or food operations: routes, 3PL dynamics, or last-mile logistics
