We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity

Grafana's Demand Generation team creates and accelerates pipeline across the full customer journey. We run a modern, AI-forward operation: lifecycle email programs driven by an AI engine, territory-level buying signals surfaced directly to sales leaders, and agentic workflows that handle work that used to take teams of specialists.

Our webinar program is one of the highest-leverage things we run: technical, practitioner-first sessions on a weekly cadence across AMER, EMEA, APAC and LATAM, putting the product in front of the people who would actually use it. Hands-on sessions, not sales pitches.

We're hiring a Webinar Program Manager to own it. This is a specialist seat, not a generalist one. You'll inherit an established program with a documented process and a full handover from the person who built it, and you'll own the operating rhythm from there: the calendar, the presenters, the build and promotion of every session, the follow-up, and the reporting.

This is not a "run the playbook" role. Sessions run in parallel at a pace no one could manage by hand, so the way to raise quality is to keep automating the mechanics. We expect this person to build with AI as a default and treat automation as a first-class deliverable, not a side project.

You'd be joining a demand gen team that is genuinely rebuilding how the function works, where AI agents run real production programs and the people on the team design the machine rather than turn the crank. The webinar program already produces, and much of the pipeline it touches starts with a session rather than a seller. You're not here to prove webinars matter. You're here to make each one produce more with less manual work behind it.

What You'll Be Doing

- Own the webinar calendar end to end. Presenter booking, registration pages, campaign setup, promotion, live delivery, follow-up, and the flip to on-demand, across multiple regions and time zones.

- Keep sessions practitioner-first. Brief technical presenters, shape the outline, and keep a session useful to the audience that registered for it.

- Bring data to topic planning. Use past performance and downstream pipeline quality to recommend what we run and what we retire, and lock the plan with demand gen and product marketing each quarter.

- Automate the production line. Extend the automation behind session setup and promotion, and keep pushing into the parts of the process a person shouldn't be doing by hand, including repurposing recordings into other content.

- Report on what happens after the session. Registrations are the input. Connect sessions to product adoption and pipeline, report it honestly, and flag what isn't producing.

- Grow the program's reach. Expand into additional languages and formats where the numbers justify it.

What Makes You a Great Fit

- 4+ years in demand generation, event marketing, or lifecycle marketing at a B2B software company (open source or developer-focused a plus).

- Hands-on ownership of a recurring webinar or virtual event calendar across multiple regions. A cadence you were accountable for hitting, not a handful of one-off sessions.

- Hands-on with a webinar platform (ON24, Zoom Webinars, Contrast, Goldcast or similar) and the plumbing behind it: CRM campaigns, registration sync, attendance data, follow-up triggers.

- Comfortable working with technical presenters. You can brief an engineer or solutions architect and hold the line on what the audience came for.

- Hands-on with AI in your actual work: you've built automations or agentic workflows (or are visibly on that path), and you think about AI as leverage, not a threat or a buzzword.

- Comfortable with data: you can pull your own numbers, sanity-check them, and build a program readout a VP would trust.

- Strong program management fundamentals. Twenty-plus moving pieces at once is a logistics job before it's a marketing job, and you ship on time without needing a coordinator.

Bonus Points For

- Content repurposing at scale: clips, blog, social, on-demand libraries.

- Localized program experience, and a view on when translation earns its cost.

- Familiarity with the observability, monitoring or open source ecosystem.

- Customer.io, Salesforce and a modern data stack (BigQuery or similar).

- Experience with product-led motions alongside sales-led ones.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

We’re hiring an Operations Lead, internally named Labs Lead, to build and run Benefits Labs, the system that governs how Gusto’s Benefits organization tests, validates, and scales operational change.

You will own the full Labs lifecycle, including intake, pilot design, execution governance, measurement, and recommendations to leadership. This is not a traditional program or operations role. Your responsibility is to build and operate the system that runs Labs.

This role is AI-native. You will design and run the agents, automations, and workflows that power how work is triaged, how pilots are executed, and how evidence is generated and synthesized. The goal is to create a system that can run many pilots in parallel with high quality and minimal manual intervention.

Your impact is measured by leverage: how much work the system can handle without you, how quickly the organization can test and scale changes, and how clearly leadership can make decisions based on evidence.

Benefits Labs sits within Benefits Business Operations today. You will be the founding operator, reporting to the Head of Benefits Business Operations, and will directly shape how this function evolves, including its future scope, structure, and investment.

About the Team:

Benefits Business Operations is responsible for how Gusto’s Benefits business improves and scales. The team operates across three domains: Automation, Carrier, and Quality, each focused on improving different parts of the operational system.

Labs sits across these domains as the governance layer for operational change. It ensures ideas are tested rigorously, measured consistently, and scaled intentionally. Labs partners closely with org leadership, product, engineering, and transformation teams to turn strategy into execution and build systems that improve how the business operates.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

You will operate and continuously improve the system that governs operational change across Benefits.

- Own intake and triage: Run the AI-powered intake system that classifies, routes, and prepares incoming work. Determine the right path for each request and improve the system over time.

- Run pilot governance: Ensure every pilot follows a clear structure with defined success metrics, checkpoints, and outputs. Use AI-driven workflows to manage execution and produce recommendations to scale, iterate, or stop.

- Raise design quality: Pressure-test hypotheses, refine success criteria, and hold Pilot Leads accountable to standards. Improve the quality of work across the system without taking ownership away from teams.

- Build and improve the system: Extend the existing agent and automation architecture across the Labs lifecycle, including intake routing, workflow execution, evidence synthesis, and readout generation. Increase speed, scope, and reliability over time.

- Solve systemic problems: Identify inefficiencies in how operational change moves through the organization and convert repeatable problems into scalable, AI-powered workflows.

- Drive decision-making: Develop analytical approaches and produce clear, evidence-based narratives that align stakeholders across product and CX and influence leadership decisions.

- Lead cross-functional work: Own coordination across product, engineering, operations, enablement, and business partners. Manage complexity, align stakeholders, and deliver measurable outcomes.

- Create clarity in ambiguity: Lead discussions on complex operational and product topics, helping teams converge on decisions and next steps.

- Produce leadership-ready outputs: Deliver structured readouts, post-mortems, and recommendations using AI to generate and validate evidence efficiently.

- Shape the future of Labs: Use what you build and learn to inform the long-term operating model, team structure, and investment strategy for Benefits Labs.

- Raise the bar for others: Coach Pilot Leads and BizOps partners on AI-powered ways of working and hold a high standard for execution quality.

Here’s what we're looking for:

- Proven ownership: You’ve owned outcomes across complex, cross-functional work and consistently delivered results end-to-end.

- AI-native builder (core requirement): You don’t just use AI tools. You build with them. You’ve designed and deployed AI agents, automations, or workflows that execute multi-step work, and you’ve measured the leverage created. This is required for success in this role.

- Systems thinker: You identify root causes at the process level and build solutions that scale. You improve how teams operate, not just your own output.

- Strong data fluency: You can structure problems, define success metrics, and turn data into clear, decision-driving narratives.

- Operator + coach: You raise the quality of work around you through direct feedback, clear standards, and accountability.

- Cross-functional leader: You’ve led initiatives across product, engineering, and operations and can drive alignment without direct authority.

- Comfort with ambiguity: You create structure where none exists and move work forward without perfect information.

Minimum experience:

4+ years in operations, program management, or business operations in a SaaS, technology, or operationally complex environment.

Bonus:

Experience in benefits, insurance, or brokerage operations. Experience working with operational metrics (e.g., cycle time, quality, throughput). Direct experience building or managing AI agents in a production or operational context.

job_desc:
At Bask Health, every role is AI-first. Work starts in an LLM to clarify intent and context, moves into the right tools to explore and execute, is tested with real users and stakeholders, and is continuously refined as we learn. AI and self-serve research are default parts of how we work, not side experiments.

We are looking for people who take full ownership of their work, treat AI as a real collaborator, and care deeply about building a company that meaningfully improves how healthcare is delivered.

We’re looking for a Visual Designer to bring this mindset to all our growth, marketing, and sales initiatives. The ideal candidate will have strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates their passion for illustrative design and typography. This candidate will have experiences in working with numerous different design platforms such as digital and print forms.

What you'll do

Define and shape our visual identity across our web presence, marketing channels, and product.

Work closely with all our marketing initiatives big and small. This means executing to a high standard across everything from our website to sales collateral, social media assets, and email campaigns.

Help us come up with creative ways to reach our audience. We’d expect you not just to help us ship quickly at a high-quality bar, but to help us figure out what we do in the first place. It might be a new kind of campaign, a content series, a set of events – you name it, the less conventional, the better.

Work AI-first: Use LLMs as your starting point — to clarify thinking, draft output, research problems, and move faster. Apply your own judgment to refine quality and make it count.

Validate and iterate: Test your work with real users and stakeholders. Use what you learn to improve before problems become patterns.

Share AI-native workflows: Document prompts, processes, and workflows that work. Share them across your team so we raise the bar together.

This is a great fit if you…

Are excited about working in a company with design-focused engineers & founders, and a culture where craft and product sense play an important role. The level of attention on design work can understandably be daunting for some folks – we’d want you to be excited about it.

Feel comfortable taking ownership of ambiguity. You should be happy with a bit of chaos and adrenaline that comes from being in a fast-moving product team.

Prefer working in the open and default to sharing early and often. You seek input from the team vs iterating on your own and presenting only your final design.

This won't be the right role if you…

Want a clear roadmap, with clearly scoped projects and tickets. We're early, growing quickly, and things are messy.

Want to focus on how things look, rather than how they perform (in addition to how they look). We're looking for someone who is excited about metrics-driven experimentation while preserving a strong sense of taste.

Want to only work on product. While you'll be joining a very product-centric culture and working closely alongside the product team, your role will predominantly be designing how we communicate the product, not the product itself.

Expect all the perks of a big company. We’re a seed-stage startup and are competitive in what we offer at our stage, but it’s a different role and opportunity than working at an established tech company.

This is NOT a UI/UX position

Requirements

Feel at home working in Figma. You should be very comfortable making things on the web and obsess over making things look and feel great.

Have an intuitive sense for good copy and how it can effectively convey an idea. You should be able to tell when a few changes to a headline really make a page sing and how words and visuals play together.

Have worked for product-led companies, ideally in SaaS. You should have an intuitive sense of how products like ours look and how they are marketed.

Ideally know your way around HTML and CSS a bit. We don’t expect you to be an expert by any stretch, but you should be comfortable fixing background colours in a pull request on Github.

Ideally have experimented with video a bit and are excited to grow this area of your skill set.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

MECHANICAL ENGINEER, SATELLITE PAYLOAD (STARLINK)

Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation, providing broadband-quality internet anywhere on earth. We’re leveraging our SpaceX knowledge in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy thousands of satellites each year; today’s constellation serves tens of millions of customers in more than 120 countries. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – the satellite hardware, the user antennas that connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. The Starlink constellation will continue to grow with increasingly powerful hardware, higher bandwidth, and a wider consumer base. We’re looking for world-class engineers to help this mission.

As a mechanical design engineer within the satellite payload group you will get to solve complex structural, thermal, and electromechanical problems on the various space grade hardware that make our satellites come to life. Our engineers get to own the full design lifecycle all the way from ideation, design, and test, through to manufacturing and largescale production. You will regularly partner with a wide variety of different cross functional engineering disciplines, and together you will usher in the next generation of highspeed internet. On this team you will be exposed to a range of different engineering challenges such as working on our state-of-the-art phased array antennas, gimballing parabolic antennas, actuators, and mechanisms, etc. If you are passionate about top tier mechanical challenges and have an interest in the world of material science, electromagnetics, and microelectronics, come help us expand the Starlink network and democratize internet access all over the world.

Own hardware from conceptual design through high volume production (typical timeline of less than one year for full product life cycle) and on-orbit operation for the Starlink constellation.

Develop design criteria, collaborate on requirements, and drive system-level optimization

Rapidly iterate on designs and analysis to inform high level systems trades and steer overall product direction

Drive holistic DFM to create elegant designs with a focus on piece part and process count reductions, error proofing at every step of fabrication and integration, and consistent performance and production metrics

Establish an efficient product lifecycle starting in the supply chain all the way through final integration that balances cost, complexity, and quality; work closely with partner teams to design and realize an efficient in-house production line

Perform environmental and performance testing on hardware to validate analysis and demonstrate compliance to design criteria

Own product delivery timeline through conception, design, assembly, and launch

Demonstrate extreme ownership of product outcomes at every stage of development and production

About Hexmodal

Hexmodal builds smart devices and a simple software platform that help facilities teams automate routine compliance testing, monitoring, and documentation. Our technology helps teams spend less time on manual rounds and more time on the maintenance work that keeps buildings operating safely. Today, Hexmodal supports more than 180 health systems across 48 states.

The Role (also the Mission)

We are looking for a Hardware Test Engineer to help us validate, qualify, and manufacture our connected compliance devices. You will work across the full test lifecycle — from bench-level characterization of new hardware, through building the automated test equipment (ATE) and fixtures used on our production lines, to writing the test software that keeps our contract manufacturers running smoothly, to building the canary fleets and reliability programs that catch issues in the field before our customers do. You will also own our RMA process end to end — when a device comes back from the field, you're the one who owns getting it diagnosed, root-caused, and closed out with a real corrective action. You put reliability and customer trust first, and you use data, not gut feel, to know when a product is truly ready. This role reports to the Head of Hardware Engineering and is based on-site at our NYC HQ.

Here are some ways you'll make an impact (also Outcomes of the role)

Develop and execute test plans for new hardware builds, including bring-up, functional characterization, environmental testing, and qualification of PCBAs and finished devices.

Design, build, and maintain automated test equipment (ATE) and custom test fixtures used in production and incoming inspection.

Own the end-to-end RMA process for defective devices returned from the field — intake, triage, diagnostic testing, and disposition of every unit that comes back from a customer site.

Write and maintain test automation software and scripts (e.g., Python) to drive test stations, collect data, and generate pass/fail reporting.

Partner with electrical, mechanical, and firmware engineers during design reviews to influence design-for-test (DFT) and design-for-manufacturing (DFM).

Analyze test and field-failure data to identify trends, drive root-cause analysis, and lead corrective actions with cross-functional teams.

Support new product introduction (NPI), transferring test procedures and fixtures from engineering to our contract manufacturers.

Troubleshoot production test failures on the line, working directly with contract manufacturing partners to resolve issues quickly.

Design and build "canary" device fleets that continuously exercise our hardware, firmware, and connectivity stack under real and simulated field conditions — power cycling, network dropout, temperature/humidity swings, RF interference, and other edge cases our products see in the field.

Own reliability testing for new and existing products, including accelerated life testing (ALT), HALT/HASS, and environmental stress screening, and translate results into design changes that close out failure modes.

Coordinate with external certification and test labs (e.g., UL, FCC, NFPA, environmental/reliability testing) — scoping test plans, shipping units, reviewing lab reports, and driving required design changes to closure.

Lead root cause analysis on field failures and RMAs, and drive corrective and preventive action (CAPA) with hardware, firmware, and manufacturing teams to close the loop so issues don't repeat.

Track and report on RMA volume, failure modes, and time-to-resolution, and use that data to prioritize what gets fixed in the next design or production revision.

Maintain clear, up-to-date test documentation, procedures, and calibration records for lab and production equipment.

Competencies we are looking for in the right candidate:

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.

3–5+ years of experience in hardware test, validation, or manufacturing test engineering for electronic products.

Hands-on experience with lab and bench equipment: oscilloscopes, DMMs, logic analyzers, power supplies, environmental chambers, and similar.

Experience designing or supporting ATE, test fixtures, or bed-of-nails / functional test setups for production environments.

Proficiency with a scripting or programming language (Python, LabVIEW, or similar) for test automation and data logging.

Solid understanding of electronics fundamentals, embedded systems, and common communication protocols (e.g., UART, SPI, I2C, BLE/Wi-Fi).

Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills, with the ability to work methodically from symptom to fix.

Comfortable working directly with contract manufacturers and cross-functional engineering teams to resolve issues under time pressure.

Working knowledge of reliability engineering concepts (e.g., MTBF/MTTF, failure rate curves, Weibull analysis) and interest in growing our accelerated life testing and field-reliability programs.

Experience owning or building an RMA / field-return process, including failure diagnosis, root cause analysis, and corrective and preventive action (CAPA).

Clear, structured communicator, comfortable presenting technical findings to both engineers and leadership.

A growth mindset and flexibility; comfortable working through ambiguity on a small, fast-moving team.

Bonus Points: (Some nice to haves for this role)

Experience testing connected/IoT devices or wireless sensor products.

Familiarity with regulatory or safety compliance testing (UL, FCC, NFPA, or similar).

Experience in healthcare, life-safety, or other highly regulated product industries.

Exposure to statistical process control (SPC) and data-driven yield improvement.

Experience running or designing accelerated life testing (ALT), HALT/HASS, or other reliability programs.

Experience building "canary" or fleet-monitoring systems that continuously validate hardware/firmware in the field or in simulated field conditions.

Experience managing relationships and test programs with external certification or reliability test labs.

Compensation & Benefits

We offer competitive compensation along with meaningful equity so you share in the value you help create.

Our benefits include:

At TerraFirma, we’re redefining how the world moves earth for construction. Founded by former SpaceX engineers and backed by Kleiner Perkins and Bain Capital Ventures, TerraFirma is automating construction to make it faster, cheaper, and safer.

Our Story & Mission

At SpaceX, we were part of the teams that built the largest rocket in human history, launched the largest constellation of satellites ever made, and delivered connectivity to millions of people worldwide. What we learned was simple: infrastructure is everything.

At Starbase, the biggest barrier to launching missions to Mars was not building the rocket. It was how slow, expensive, and complex it was to build the infrastructure around it. We lacked buildings, roads, water, power, communications, and waste management, and constructing them took far more time and resources than it should have.

From a first-principles perspective, that doesn't make sense. It shouldn't be this hard or costly to create the foundations for progress. That’s when we realized something important: the same engineering mindset that enabled us to tackle space exploration and mass manufacturing could be applied to infrastructure. By bringing the principles of simplification, iteration, acceleration, and automation to construction, we can unlock a new era in how the world builds.

Accelerating infrastructure unlocks progress across every domain, creating a self-sustaining engine for tackling humanity’s toughest challenges. The innovations we develop on Earth will lay the groundwork for the technologies that one day make settlement on Mars possible.

Job Overview

As a Civil Engineer, you will play a crucial role in planning, calculating, and supervising infrastructure development projects. Your primary goal will be to ensure that all projects are executed while balancing safety, environmental regulations, and budget constraints. This position involves a mix of office-based design and software work, along with field-based construction site inspections.

Key Responsibilities

1. **Planning & Design**: You will analyze survey reports, maps, and environmental data to draft structural blueprints and site layouts using computer software. Your expertise will be essential in creating designs that meet both functional and aesthetic requirements.

2. **Feasibility & Risk Assessment**: Conducting technical and feasibility studies will be part of your responsibilities. You will analyze soil and building material strength and assess project risks to ensure the viability of construction plans.

3. **Site Supervision & Quality Control**: Monitoring daily construction activities will be critical. You will inspect materials such as concrete and steel, ensuring that all work aligns with approved plans and adheres to safety codes.

4. **Cost Estimation & Budgeting**: You will calculate material quantities, prepare cost estimates (Bill of Quantities / BOQ), and track project expenditures to maintain financial control over projects.

5. **Regulatory Compliance**: Submitting permit applications and ensuring compliance with local, state, and national building or environmental laws will be part of your role, ensuring that all projects meet legal standards.

6. **Stakeholder Coordination**: Liaising with architects, contractors, clients, and government agencies will be essential to resolve site issues and keep projects on schedule. Your communication skills will be vital in fostering collaboration among all parties involved.

This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to significant infrastructure projects while ensuring safety and compliance. If you are passionate about civil engineering and ready to take on new challenges, we encourage you to apply.

job_desc:
Joining Arup

Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. Arup is a UK-headquartered independent firm of designers, planners, engineers, consultants, and technical specialists offering a wide range of professional services. With 90 offices in 35 countries, their 19,000+ staff make a positive difference in the world through their work.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a motivated and technically competent Civil Engineer to support the planning, design, coordination, and delivery of infrastructure, mix used development, airports, data centre projects.The role will involve civil engineering design across the project lifecycle, including site development, grading, drainage, roads and pavements, underground utilities, external works, and coordination with structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, and other engineering disciplines. The successful candidate should have strong technical fundamentals and the ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams on complex and fast-paced projects. Working within a multidisciplinary team, the role will take technical ownership of design packages and drive the development of safe, compliant, and well‑coordinated design solutions, with a focus on utilities such as water, electricity, telecoms, and highways‑related works.

Key Responsibilities

The role involves delivering civil engineering design for data centres, industrial, commercial, and infrastructure projects. Responsibilities include site grading, earthworks, roads, pavements, drainage, external works, and utility infrastructure design. The engineer will develop stormwater drainage strategies, coordinate finished levels, utilities, attenuation, and discharge requirements. The role requires preparation and review of calculations, drawings, specifications, technical reports, and design documentation. Coordination with structural, architectural, MEP, BIM, geotechnical, landscape, and other disciplines is essential. The engineer will review surveys, site investigation information, contractor drawings, RFIs, and technical submissions. Responsibilities also include identifying and managing design risks, clashes, interfaces, and constructability issues. Designs must comply with Indian Standards, local authority requirements, client standards, and relevant international codes. The role includes client and authority coordination for technical approvals and consents. The engineer will review and oversee 3D designs using Autodesk Civil 3D and ensure BIM compliance with ISO 19650. Responsibilities also include mentoring junior engineers, maintaining quality standards, and supporting project planning, fee proposals, resources, bids, and business development.

Is this role right for you?

Minimum 8 years’ experience with a degree in Civil, Utilities, Infrastructure Engineering, or a related discipline

Strong experience in civil infrastructure design, particularly drainage, highways, utilities, grading, earthworks, roads, and external works.

Advanced working knowledge of Autodesk Civil 3D, including reviewing and guiding 3D model development.

Experience with drainage/hydraulic modelling, SuDS, stormwater management, and flood-risk considerations.

Good understanding of Indian and international design standards, regulations, technical approvals, and authority requirements.

Sound knowledge of BIM processes and ISO 19650, with experience managing design deliverables

Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, coordinate with stakeholders, and manage client relationships..

Chartered Engineer (CEng/ICE) or near chartership preferred, with experience mentoring and developing junior engineers

Strong communication, technical report writing, leadership, and decision-making skills, with a proactive and quality-focused approach

Not ready to apply just yet, or have a few questions? Contact (Nisha.Gulati-nisha.gulati@arup.com). Please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email.

Reward And Benefits

We offer a competitive salary at all levels, and one of the best benefits packages in our sector. Core benefits include Provident Fund contribution, NPS option, Mediclaim cover (incl. family), Term Life and Accident Insurance, Employee Assistance Prog. scheme for the family to safeguard your physical and mental wellbeing. In addition, all permanent employees are eligible for the Global Profit Share scheme. Subject to scheme rules employees can receive two Profit Share payments per year, which are dependent on the firm’s financial performance.

Different people, shared values.

At Arup, we believe when talented people collaborate, great things are possible. Arup hires people with proven skills and open minds. We are taking deliberate action to create an inclusive culture that is grounded in our purpose to shape a better world.

At Arup, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and any other protected characteristic. Our internal employee networks - BAME, Culture, Disability, LGBTQ+ and Women - provide a space for you to express your views and to make a positive difference - discover more about life at Arup here.

At Arup, we are committed to making all stages of our recruitment process accessible to candidates with disabilities. Please speak to our recruitment team and we will work with you to make reasonable adjustments to ensure you can perform at your best throughout your application.

At Arup, we appreciate that everyone’s circumstances are different and having the freedom to flex the way we work is essential to our wellbeing. If flexibility matters to you let us know when you apply, and we will discuss how this could work in your role.

What happens next?

If this could be the next step in your journey, please apply online. All applications will be considered, and we will try our very best to respond to you within 72 hours of receiving your application.

Stay safe online - Arup will never ask for payment or your bank details as part of our recruitment process

Recruitment Agencies - We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list.

We may close the role earlier than the advertised date should we receive a large number of applications, so please ensure you apply early.

When you apply, please make sure the subject line reads: "I actually read the instructions."

MindShift Studios is a digital marketing agency in Saint Johns, FL. We work primarily with longevity clinics, health practitioners, health supplements and wellness brands helping ambitious businesses build the future of how people live longer, healthier lives.

We're data-driven by default. Every recommendation, every strategy, every report is grounded in numbers we can defend. Gut feelings are a starting point. Data is how we win.

We're hiring a full-time SEO Specialist on a hybrid basis split between our Saint Johns, FL office and remote. You'll need to be in or willing to relocate to the Jacksonville area.

You'll manage our entire SEO division owning technical SEO, on-page and off-page strategy, AI SEO and GEO strategy, long-tail strategy, content writing, guest posting, link building, LinkedIn outreach, reporting and measurement, and client communication.

You'll start with 3 client accounts and grow into a portfolio of 8 to 10 over your first 60 days. You'll report to our Project Manager and our COO, but the SEO practice is yours to run.

Technical SEO • Run comprehensive site audits and prioritize fixes by impact: site speed, Core Web Vitals, schema, indexation, redirects, canonicalization, mobile usability. Diagnose with Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, and PageSpeed Insights.

On-Page SEO • Architect content that ranks. Keyword research, search intent mapping, topic clusters, pillar pages, schema, internal linking, and content depth. Build topical authority across longevity and health verticals.

Off-Page SEO • Run quality backlink campaigns through outreach, digital PR, and partnerships. No PBNs. No spam. Real links from real sites with real audiences. Track DR, referring domains, and link velocity tied to ranking and traffic outcomes.

AI SEO and GEO • Lead our practice in optimizing for AI-powered search: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. Build and improve AI workflows using Claude that scale our output and quality. This is the future of SEO, and you're going to help us own it.

Long-Tail Strategy • Build content programs that capture qualified, high-intent traffic our competitors miss. The long tail is where small businesses outrank giants • and you know how to execute on it.

Content Writing • Write or oversee SEO-optimized content that ranks and converts. Blog posts, service pages, landing pages, location pages, and pillar content. You can write yourself when needed, brief writers when you can't, and edit ruthlessly either way. Every piece is tied to a keyword strategy and a measurable outcome.

Guest Posting & Backlinks • Build and execute guest posting campaigns that earn high-DR backlinks from reputable health, wellness, and longevity publications. Pitch editors, write contributor-quality drafts, and turn placements into long-term partnerships. No PBNs. No spam. Real placements on real sites with real audiences.

LinkedIn Outreach • Run campaigns for partnership building, founder positioning, digital PR, and authority building • for our agency and our clients.

Client Communication • Lead monthly strategy calls, deliver reports, and serve as the primary day-to-day contact for your portfolio. Translate technical work into language clients act on.

Reporting and Measurement • Track everything. Clients should always know exactly what's working, why, and what's next.

QUALIFICATIONS

SEO Technical Stack (Required)

Google Search Console, Ahrefs and/or Semrush, Screaming Frog, GA4 • daily fluency

On-page SEO • keyword research, content optimization, internal linking, topic clustering

Off-page SEO • proven backlink experience through outreach and digital PR

Technical SEO • site speed, schema, Core Web Vitals, indexation, redirects, canonicalization

WordPress • comfortable with HTML and CSS edits

AI and Tools (Required)

Claude (claude.ai) proficiency • daily use, with examples to show

AI SEO experience • you understand how AI search engines crawl, evaluate, and surface content

Data fluency • you live in spreadsheets and dashboards and turn numbers into stories

LinkedIn outreach • you know how to write messages that get responses

Skills and Approach (Required)

Client-facing experience • comfortable leading calls and delivering hard truths

Clear, confident communication in English

Self-directed and accountable

Data-driven mindset

Bonus Points

Longevity, health, wellness, or functional medicine industry experience

Looker Studio or other reporting platforms

HTML, CSS, or JavaScript fluency for technical fixes

SALARY AND GROWTH

SEO Specialist starts at $52,000 per year. You'll lead our SEO practice from day one. Compensation grows alongside the practice you build.

Start with 3 client accounts while learning our systems

Within 60 days, grow into a full portfolio of 8 to 10 accounts

Performance graded on client retention, satisfaction, traffic growth, ranking improvements, and outreach results

MAKE SURE YOU'RE COMFORTABLE WITH...

Hybrid work in the Saint Johns, FL area

Client-facing responsibility • you're the primary contact for your accounts

AI-forward culture • everyone here uses Claude daily

Data-driven decisions • if you don't like measuring, this isn't your role

Outreach work • writing messages, building relationships, asking for things

60-day trial period • don't leave a comfortable job unless you're confident

Camera on for all virtual meetings

OUR VALUES

Core Values • What We Stand For

Truth: No jargon, no spin, no hiding behind metrics. If something isn't working, we say so.

Health: We serve human health and live what we preach.

Abundance: We operate from a worldview of more, not less. There's enough opportunity, growth, and success to go around.

Community: We're stronger together. We invest in our team, our clients, and the communities we serve.

Operational Values • How We Work

Gift of Uniqueness: No cookie-cutter solutions. We find what makes each client one-of-a-kind.

Pursuit of Clarity: Plain language, clear deliverables, real reporting.

Spark of Creativity: The best solutions aren't in playbooks. We test, experiment, and try what others won't.

Spirit of Disruption: We work with founders challenging the status quo. Question everything. Push back. Make it better.

Send the following to

chris@mindshiftstudios.com

with the subject line "I actually read the instructions."

About you • brief description of your SEO experience, client-facing experience, and why you'd be a great fit

Location confirmation • you're in the Jacksonville area or willing to relocate

Interview readiness • confirm you'll be ready to present your AI workflows, data work, and outreach examples live

ONE LAST THING

We know this is a lot. That's intentional.

Most agencies are looking for warm bodies to fill seats. We're looking for the person who's been waiting for a role like this • someone who reads this posting and thinks, "Finally."

If that's you, follow the instructions. Show us your work. The right person doesn't need convincing.

— The MindShift Studios Team

About Futurex Management Solutions Limited

Futurex is a payroll and compliance partner for startups, SMEs, and growing businesses across India. We handle end-to-end payroll processing, statutory filings (PF, ESI, PT, TDS, GST), HR and ROC compliance, and accounting and bookkeeping, so our clients can focus on growing their business. We also provide IT services, including infrastructure management, software support, data security, and cloud solutions.

We're growing our digital presence and are looking for an SEO Executive to help businesses find us when they search for payroll, compliance, and IT support.

What You'll Do

Own On-Page SEO:

Optimise brands' service pages, landing pages and blogs across payroll, HR outsourcing, statutory compliance, accounting, staffing and IT services. That means titles, meta tags, headings, internal links and schema.

Keyword Research & Mapping:

Find high-intent B2B keywords, build keyword clusters and map them to the right pages so each page targets a clear search intent.

Technical SEO Health:

Run regular site audits for crawl errors, broken links, redirects, page speed, Core Web Vitals, indexing and mobile usability. Work with the developer team to get fixes live.

Off-Page & Local SEO:

Build quality backlinks through guest posts, business listings and directories. Manage and optimise the Google Business Profile.

Content Collaboration:

Give writers SEO briefs and review drafts for keyword use, structure and search intent. Stuffing keywords is not the goal.

Track & Report:

Monitor rankings, organic traffic and leads using Google Search Console, GA4 and SEO tools. Share weekly and monthly reports with clear next steps.

What We're Looking For

1–3 years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably in a B2B, SaaS, or services business

Strong command of keyword research, on-page SEO, and technical SEO fundamentals

Proven link-building experience with a focus on quality over volume

Working knowledge of Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and at least one of SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz, or Screaming Frog

Basic understanding of WordPress (familiarity with HTML is a plus)

Ability to turn data into clear insights and action plans

Excellent written English and a sharp eye for detail

Comfortable managing multiple projects and working across teams

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, IT, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Good to Have

Experience doing SEO for finance, HR, compliance, or accounting websites

Exposure to Google Ads or other performance marketing channels

Familiarity with AI-driven search (Google AI Overviews and similar) and how to optimise for it

How We'll Measure Success

Growth in organic traffic and keyword rankings for priority service pages

Increase in leads and enquiries from organic search

Improved site health scores and Core Web Vitals

Growth in quality referring domains

How to Apply

Click Easy Apply

この役割は、実務オペレーション、カスタマーサービス、およびドキュメンテーション業務を組み合わせたものであり、シームレスなサプライチェーンの実行を提供しながら、日本のゲートウェイ全体の効率性、貨物量の成長、および収益性を推進します。

予約の受付、荷送人/荷受人および代理店と連絡を取り、提供されたSOPの範囲内で出荷を手配する。

顧客/代理店へのタイムリーな請求、および下請け業者からの請求書の期日通りの正確な確認と承認。

- Customer service by following up on customer advices/request or claim and feedback to customer and overseas and make respective shipment arrangement.

Prepare, verify, and maintain mandatory SEZ documentation (e.g., Form A, Annexure-V, SER/PER records) for smooth clearance and tracking. Support receiving, inspection, storage, internal delivery and dispatch activities with local stakeholders. Work with designated Pune and Chennai contacts to confirm receipt, quantities, serial numbers, asset handover and dispatch activities. Track shipments from pickup through final delivery, ensuring receiving confirmations, proof of delivery and supporting documentation are completed before operational closure. Support domestic movements between Arista locations, suppliers, contract manufacturers, repair vendors and other approved third-party service providers. Support return-to-vendor, repair, replacement, temporary removal and equipment return activities. Escalate shipment delays, missing documentation and operational issues promptly to the appropriate stakeholders. Coordinate with Pune and Chennai contacts to validate inventory records and movement status. Support hardware deployments, transfers, recoveries, refresh activities, and end-of-life equipment movements. Maintain complete, organised and audit-ready records supporting Finance, Global Trade Compliance and SEZ requirements. Resolve shipment and inventory issues promptly while keeping stakeholders informed. Work effectively with internal stakeholders and external partners to support operational objectives. Demonstrate ownership by following every shipment and inventory movement through to successful completion. Continuously improve knowledge, operational effectiveness and attention to detail. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right. We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools. Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature. Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun. Experience Level Entry Level

Product Researcher

About Bask Health

Bask Health is building the infrastructure that powers modern telehealth businesses.

Our platform enables healthcare companies to launch, operate, and scale digital care experiences, from patient onboarding and clinical workflows to prescriptions, payments, subscriptions, fulfillment, and ongoing care.

We move quickly, work across complex healthcare problems, and believe deeply understanding our users is essential to building the right products.

We're looking for a

Product Researcher

to help us understand those users, uncover meaningful problems, and turn evidence into better product decisions.

About the Role

As a Product Researcher at Bask, your job is not simply to validate designs. You'll help us determine

what we should build, why it matters, and whether what we shipped actually improved the experience.

You'll work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, and other teams to identify important questions, investigate user behavior, and turn ambiguous signals into clear product opportunities.

Our users span multiple sides of the telehealth ecosystem, including healthcare businesses, operators, providers, and patients. You'll develop a deep understanding of how these groups work, where they struggle, and where Bask can create meaningful leverage.

We value researchers who are pragmatic, curious, comfortable with ambiguity, and focused on outcomes rather than research ceremony.

What You'll Do

Partner with Product and Design to identify the highest-value questions to answer before solutions are defined.

Conduct qualitative and quantitative research across customers, operators, providers, and patients to understand their needs, behaviors, motivations, and pain points.

Build continuous relationships with users so research becomes an ongoing input into product development rather than something that happens only around individual projects.

Combine user interviews, usability testing, surveys, product analytics, support feedback, customer conversations, and business context to develop a complete understanding of user behavior.

Identify unmet needs, inefficient workflows, emerging behaviors, and opportunities that can influence Bask's product strategy and roadmap.

Turn ambiguous research findings into clear insights, product opportunities, recommendations, and prioritization decisions.

Challenge assumptions and help teams distinguish between what users ask for and the underlying problems they actually need solved.

Design lightweight experiments and research approaches appropriate to the level of uncertainty. We value getting reliable answers quickly over unnecessary research ceremony.

Work closely with designers throughout the product development process, from early concepts through prototypes and production experiences.

Conduct usability testing and evaluate prototypes to identify friction before products are shipped.

Evaluate shipped experiences to understand whether product changes actually improved user behavior and outcomes.

Help identify opportunities where AI and automation can meaningfully improve healthcare workflows while understanding where human judgment and control remain essential.

Use AI-assisted research workflows to increase the speed and breadth of research operations and synthesis while maintaining strong judgment around evidence quality, bias, privacy, and research validity.

Create journey maps, research reports, personas, frameworks, or other artifacts when they meaningfully improve communication or decision-making—not simply as deliverables.

Build systems that make research insights accessible and useful across Product, Design, Engineering, and the broader company.

How We Think About Research

At Bask, research isn't a step in the design process.

It's a way of reducing uncertainty.

Sometimes that means spending significant time understanding a complex workflow. Sometimes it means talking to five customers this week. Sometimes it means analyzing behavioral data, testing a prototype, reviewing support conversations, or running a quick experiment.

We're less interested in the number of research artifacts you produce and more interested in

what changed because of what you learned.

The best researchers at Bask will help us answer three questions:

Are we solving a real problem?

Are we solving it in the right way?

Did the experience actually get better after we shipped it?

What Success Looks Like

You'll be successful in this role when teams involve research before solutions are defined, product decisions are increasingly grounded in evidence rather than assumptions, and Bask develops a deeper shared understanding of its customers and patients.

Most importantly, your work will help us build fewer things that don't matter and build the things that do with much greater confidence.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

Proven experience in Product Research, UX Research, User Research, or a similar role within a digital product organization.

A strong track record of taking ambiguous product questions, determining what evidence is needed, gathering it efficiently, and influencing meaningful product decisions.

Experience with qualitative research methods including user interviews, usability testing, contextual inquiry, and concept testing.

Experience using quantitative signals such as surveys, product analytics, experiments, or behavioral data alongside qualitative research.

Strong analytical thinking and the ability to distinguish meaningful patterns from noise.

Excellent synthesis skills—you can take large amounts of messy information and turn them into a clear understanding of what matters and why.

Strong product judgment and an understanding of how research connects to product strategy, design, engineering constraints, and business outcomes.

The ability to communicate research findings clearly and persuasively to designers, engineers, product managers, executives, and other stakeholders.

Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where questions may be ambiguous and the ideal research methodology isn't always obvious.

A pragmatic approach to research. You know when a question requires rigorous investigation and when a lightweight approach can provide enough confidence to move forward.

Experience collaborating closely with Product and Design throughout discovery, development, and post-launch evaluation.

Comfort using modern AI tools to accelerate research workflows while maintaining critical thinking and independent judgment.

Curiosity about how AI is changing user behavior, software interfaces, and the way products are designed and built.

Nice to Have

Experience with B2B SaaS, healthcare, telehealth, fintech, marketplaces, or other complex software platforms.

Experience researching products with multiple user types or sides of a marketplace.

Experience working with product analytics and behavioral data.

Experience conducting research in regulated or privacy-sensitive environments.

Experience researching AI-powered products, automation, or workflows involving human-AI collaboration.

Experience establishing research practices, repositories, or continuous discovery programs within a growing product organization.

Junior Associate - Design Researcher

Role Overview

We are hiring a Design Researcher with about 1 year of experience who can look at any design, say clearly why it works or fails, and turn that into layout rules our designers can use.

Job title : Design Researcher

Experience : 1 year

Employment type : Full-time

Location : Bangalore

Works with : UI/UX designers, graphic designers, developers, account managers

About this Role

This role sits between thinking and making. You will not be judged mainly on how many screens or posters you produce. You will be judged on how well you study, explain and systemise design.

You should be someone who loves talking about designs. Show you a brochure, a website or a mobile app screen, and you can explain:

What kind of design it is

— UI design, UX design, graphic design, or a mix — and why that difference matters for how it is judged.

How the layout is built

— grid, columns, spacing, alignment, hierarchy, type scale and visual flow.

Why it works for its industry

— what that industry's audience needs to see first, and whether the design delivers it.

Your research becomes the playbook our designers follow when they start a new project in any industry vertical.

Key Responsibilities

1. Speak and explain design

Break down any design (website, app, brochure, social post, hoarding) and explain its intent, structure and weaknesses in plain language.

Present design reviews to designers, account managers and clients, and defend design decisions with clear reasoning.

Write short design rationales that go along with every major deliverable.

2. Classify the type of design

Identify whether a brief needs UI design, UX design, graphic design, or a combination.

Explain the difference to non-designers: UX is how it works and flows, UI is how the interface looks and behaves, graphic design is visual communication for print, social and brand.

Recommend the right skill mix and process for each project.

3. Dive deep into layout systems

Study and document grid systems (12-column web grids, modular grids, baseline grids, 8-pt spacing systems).

Analyse visual hierarchy, typography scales, white space, alignment, and reading patterns such as F-pattern and Z-pattern.

Build reusable layout templates and component rules for websites, landing pages, brochures and social creatives.

Audit existing work against these systems and flag inconsistencies.

4. Research vertical-based design

Build design playbooks for each industry vertical the team works on.

Study competitors, award-winning work and current trends in each vertical, and summarise what works.

Map what each vertical's audience needs to see, in what order, and translate that into layout guidance.

Keep a living reference library (mood boards, swipe files, annotated examples) per vertical.

5. Support design and research work

Run light user research: short surveys, usability checks, heatmap and analytics reviews, stakeholder interviews.

Help designers with wireframes, layout drafts and reference packs before visual design starts.

Share findings in short decks or docs and run occasional internal design talks.

Verticals and design work you will cover

You will research design across every industry vertical we work in, and any new one we take on. For each vertical, you study the audience, competitors and design conventions, then turn them into layout guidance for the work types below.

1. Graphic design

What you will study: Brochures, print ads, outdoor and hoardings, social media creatives, campaign key visuals, brand collateral.

Layout focus: Visual hierarchy, typography, image-to-text balance, brand consistency across formats.

2. Web design

What you will study: Websites, microsites, landing pages, listing and detail pages.

Layout focus: Grid systems, section order, responsive behaviour, CTA and form placement.

3. UI/UX design

What you will study: App screens, user flows, forms, enquiry, booking and checkout journeys, dashboards.

Layout focus: Navigation, information architecture, interaction patterns, usability and accessibility.

Required Skills & Qualifications

About 1 year of experience in design research, UI/UX design, graphic design, or a design-strategy role (internships count).

Degree or diploma in design, visual communication, HCI, architecture, fine arts, or equivalent portfolio.

Strong ability to

speak about design

— clear, confident explanation of why a layout, colour or type choice works.

Clear understanding of the difference between UI design, UX design and graphic design.

Solid grasp of layout fundamentals: grids, spacing systems, hierarchy, typography, alignment and white space.

Working knowledge of Figma; basic use of Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator or InDesign.

Good written English for design rationales, research summaries and presentations.

A portfolio or case study that shows research thinking, not only final visuals.

Nice to have

Experience creating or maintaining a design system or component library.

Familiarity with research and analytics tools such as Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Google Analytics, Maze or Notion.

Experience giving design talks, writing design blogs or running workshops.

Comfort in English plus one regional language for client and user conversations.

Hiring Process and How to Apply

Portfolio review

— share a portfolio with at least one case study that shows your research and reasoning.

Design talk-through (30 min)

— we show you two designs from different verticals, one website and one print piece. You explain the type of design, the layout system behind it, and what you would improve.

Take-home task (3–4 hours)

— pick a website from any vertical and write a one-page layout teardown: grid, hierarchy, section order, lead-form placement, and three specific improvements.

Final conversation

— meet the Design Lead and team.

To apply: send your CV and portfolio link to [hiring email] with the subject line "Design Researcher – [Your Name]".
